5H.Dw6a: a higher-order continuity-renewal lineage is warranted only when every current warrant carries an executable failure→reacquisition→revision→retest route for producing a successor; the repair relation has independent recurrence support rather than only self-reported replayability; every successor explicitly re-witnesses the distinctions it is allowed to ignore and preserves addresses back to omitted evidence; and predecessor/current/successor authority remains versioned, reflexively falsifiable, provenance-preserving, and freshly witnessed.
2H.0aZJ: a cross-substrate relation can become selectively actionable without canonical identity when the public interface preserves claim-relevant operations and role semantics, carries separate scope/obligation/propagation/evidence warrants, and remains sufficient under pressure-aligned carrier variation; successful action or portability does not by itself upgrade evidence, mechanism or identity claims.
2H.kfmG: continuity may be obligation-indexed and regenerative rather than snapshot-complete: preserve enough bounded state to reinstantiate the externally relevant relation required by the current downstream obligation, plus independent identity/transport/assurance/propagation/evidence warrants; boundary changes trigger local revalidation rather than global reset, and successful regeneration does not establish shared mechanism, global equivalence, or stronger evidence.
4H.ugTO: continuity authority regenerates lawfully only when failure is independently witnessed, localized across frontier/role/quotient/regime, tied to exact evidence return paths, and followed by executable reconstruction plus replay of the admissibility test; unaffected warrants remain scope-bounded and repaired authority is a freshly witnessed successor, never inherited permission.
2H.LlIB: a noncanonical cross-substrate interface may stand in for shared state or shared identity only for a named downstream obligation inside a witnessed local validity regime: preserve claim-relevant operations and consequential distinctions, keep admissible variation and failure coordinates explicit, and reissue the affected continuity warrant whenever that regime changes; durable correspondence remains nonidentity.
3H.1OFJ: actionable continuity across changing representations is renewable rather than permanent: carry a minimal obligation-specific relational kernel together with its separate action/evidence warrants and regime-valid rewrite law; after change, regenerate the relation and freshly reauthorize exactly the affected coordinates before treating portability as current again.
